counterexamples.finding: Dry-run profile/count validation is useful but does not execute owner commands or provide runtime API/database measurements.
The joint L2 fixture is a bounded P6 proof and cannot be relabeled as the full r5-full seed denominator.
The single DEV-only bootstrap SQL stage is explicitly non-API and must remain a separate stage receipt.

findings.confirmedRootCause: After profile and confirmation checks, the command unconditionally exits OWNER_COMMAND_EXECUTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no seed execution or finally-written report exists.
The fixture records phase/status only; it does not bind operationId/method/normalized route, HTTP duration, database operation count/duration, or request completion correlation.

The runtime has no request-local logical database operation tracker attached to the application DataSource and no seed-mode request-completed event stream from which a report can safely derive DB statistics.
The accepted P6 fixture denominator and the proposed r5-full fixture denominator are separate; using one as proof for the other would be a scope alias rather than completion.
The JSON report is suitable for machine validation but does not provide a Dexter-readable summary of conclusion, endpoint metrics, non-API stages and business/cleanup boundaries.
